targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  unix_timestamp(created) AS "time"
  ,avg(case when name in ('tempout','tempf') then vavg else null end) as 'Outside'
  ,avg(case when name in ('tempin','tempinf') then vavg else null end) as 'Main Floor'
FROM (
  SELECT name, created, value AS vmin, value AS vmax, value AS vavg
    FROM weather WHERE $__timeFilter(created)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, bucket_start AS created, min_value AS vmin, max_value AS vmax, avg_value AS vavg
    FROM weather_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
) weather
where
name in ('tempin','tempout','tempinf','tempf')
 and
 $__timeFilter(created)
Group by   unix_timestamp(created) 
ORDER BY created

SELECT
UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created)*1000 DIV $__interval_ms * $__interval_ms  AS "time"
,avg(case when displayName in ('Office Hue Motion Sensor') then value else null end) as 'Office'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Simon motion and temp') then value else null end) as 'Boys Room'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Master bed motion sensor') then value else null end) as 'Master Bed'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Basement family motion') then value else null end) as 'Basement'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Garage Motion on Home 3') then value else null end) as 'Garage'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Cold storage water sensor') then value else null end) as 'Cold Storage'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Fridge Temp') then value else null end) as 'Fridge'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Freezer Temp') then value else null end) as 'Freezer'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Ecowitt Remote 7') then value else null end) as 'Attic'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Adrienne Office Motion ST') then value else null end) as 'Adrienne Office'


FROM temperatures
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created)
  AND
  displayName IN (
    'Master bed motion sensor',
    'Basement family motion',
    'Garage Motion on Home 3',
    'Cold storage water sensor',
    'Fridge Temp',
    'Ecowitt Remote 7',
    'Freezer Temp',
    'Simon motion and temp',
    'Office Hue Motion Sensor',
    'Adrienne Office Motion ST'
  )
  
GROUP BY  1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created)*1000 DIV $__interval_ms * $__interval_ms  AS "time"
,avg(case when displayName in ('Master bed motion sensor') then value else null end) as Upstairs
,avg(case when displayName in ('Basement family motion') then value else null end) as 'Basement'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Garage Motion on Home 3') then value else null end) as 'Garage'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Cold storage water sensor') then value else null end) as 'Cold Storage'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Simon motion and temp') then value else null end) as 'Simon Room'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Adrienne Office Motion ST') then value else null end) as 'Adrienne Office'
FROM temperatures
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created)
  and
  displayName in ('Master bed motion sensor','Basement family motion','Garage Motion on Home 3','Cold storage water sensor','Fridge Temp','Simon motion and temp','Adrienne Office Motion ST')
GROUP BY  1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  unix_timestamp(created) AS "time"
  ,avg(case when name in('tempin','tempinf') then vavg else null end) as 'Main Floor'
  ,avg(case when name in('tempf','temp') then vavg else null end) as 'Outside'
FROM (
  SELECT name, created, value AS vmin, value AS vmax, value AS vavg
    FROM weather WHERE $__timeFilter(created)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, bucket_start AS created, min_value AS vmin, max_value AS vmax, avg_value AS vavg
    FROM weather_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
) weather
where
name in ('tempin', 'tempinf','tempf','temp')
 and
 $__timeFilter(created)
Group by   unix_timestamp(created) 
ORDER BY created

SELECT
 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created)*1000 DIV $__interval_ms * $__interval_ms  AS "time"
,avg(case when displayName in ('Master bed motion sensor') then value else null end) as Upstairs
,avg(case when displayName in ('Ecowitt Remote 7') then value else null end) as 'Attic'
FROM temperatures
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created)
  and
  displayName in ('Master bed motion sensor','Ecowitt Remote 7')
GROUP BY  1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created)*1000 DIV $__interval_ms * $__interval_ms AS "time"
  ,avg(case when name in ('tempout','tempf') then vavg else null end) as 'Outside Temp'
FROM (
  SELECT name, created, value AS vmin, value AS vmax, value AS vavg
    FROM weather WHERE $__timeFilter(created)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, bucket_start AS created, min_value AS vmin, max_value AS vmax, avg_value AS vavg
    FROM weather_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
) weather
where
name in ('tempout','tempf')
and
 $__timeFilter(created)
Group by   1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created)*1000 DIV $__interval_ms * $__interval_ms  AS "time"
,avg(case when displayName in ('Fridge Temp') then value else null end) as 'Fridge'
,avg(case when displayName in ('Freezer Temp') then value else null end) as 'Freezer'
FROM temperatures
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created)
  and
  displayName in ('Fridge Temp','Freezer Temp')
GROUP BY  1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
unix_timestamp(created) AS "time"
,case when value='idle' then null 
      when value='heating' then 1 else null end as 'Heater'
,case when value='idle' then null 
      when value='cooling' then 1 else null end as 'AC'
,case when value='idle' then null
      when value in ('fan only','fan') then 1 else null end as 'Fan'
FROM thermostat
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created)

GROUP BY 
unix_timestamp(created)
ORDER BY created

SELECT
unix_timestamp(DateDTS) AS "time"
,case when ProgramNM = 'Home' then 1 else null end as 'Home'
,case when ProgramNM = 'HomeFan' then 1 else null end as 'HomeFan'
,case when ProgramNM = 'Away' then 1 else null end as 'Away'
,case when ProgramNM = 'AwayFan' then 1 else null end as 'AwayFan'
,case when ProgramNM  in ('Sleep','Night') then 1 else null end as 'Sleep'
,case when ProgramNM in ('SleepFan','NightFan') then 1 else null end as 'SleepFan'
,case when ProgramNM = 'Windows' then 1 else null end as 'Windows'
,case when ProgramNM = 'WindowsFan' then 1 else null end as 'WindowsFan'
,case when ProgramNM not in ('Home', 'HomeFan', 'Solar', 'SolarFan', 'SolarMid', 'SolarMidFan', 'Away', 'AwayFan', 'Sleep', 'SleepFan', 'Windows', 'WindowsFan','NightFan','Night') then 1 else null end as 'Other'

FROM ThermostatProgram
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(DateDTS)

SELECT
unix_timestamp(dateDTS) AS "time"
,setPoint
,currentTemperature
FROM EcobeeStatus
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
